1) route names: recorded "partial" because the transaction name carried a spurious "/app" prefix (GET /app/api/users/[id]) and disagreed with event.transaction (GET /api/users/[id]). The recorded explanation is still true line for line - the Sentry runtime hook is still not registered on bun ("[Sentry] Runtime hook not registered"), the bundler plugin still injects nothing ("injected libraries=[]"), and mysql2/promise is still left external and never patched in .next/server/app/api/db/route.js. The spans arrive by a path the record did not have available: mysql2 3.24.3 ships its own diagnostics_channel tracing in node_modules/mysql2/lib/tracing.js (tracingChannel('mysql2:query'), 'mysql2:connect', 'mysql2:pool:connect', 'mysql2:execute'), and the SDK's "Bun/Deno, subscribing eagerly" branch subscribes to exactly those.
